purpose: Provide one cross-agent authority and lifecycle model for durable state, artifacts, files, caches, external references and chat-only context, including verified file operations without creating parallel policy surfaces.

universal_control_plane_owns: minimum artifact identity and provenance rules
conflict handling between authority and lower-authority context
domain_owner_owns: artifact formats and business invalidation graph
promotion of domain learning into domain rules

ENGINEERING_AUTHORITY.cleanup: Keep one current active implementation; superseded implementations belong in Git history unless an explicit migration edge still requires them.

DURABLE_TASK_STATE.cleanup: Never delete or rewrite merely because protocol/Skill changed; migrate through owner/Continuity compatibility rules.

BUSINESS_EVIDENCE.cleanup: Owner-defined retention; never delete evidence required for causality, audit, publication, accepted output, migration or active next_action.

LEARNING_EVIDENCE.cleanup: Retain provenance while relevant; raw evidence cannot silently become a durable rule.

REBUILDABLE_CACHE.cleanup: Delete or rebuild when stale, schema/source-version mismatched or superseded; cache is never commit proof.

SESSION_SCRATCH.cleanup: Ephemeral by default; not a recovery source until intentionally promoted.

EXTERNAL_REFERENCE.cleanup: Presence does not imply authority; stale/duplicate active references should be removed or quarantined when safe.

CHAT_PERSONALIZATION_CONTEXT.cleanup: Use for routing/preferences/scoped instructions; never substitute for authoritative task state.

authority_rules.account_custom_instructions: Global routing/UX guard surface, not durable business state.
authority_rules.project_instructions: Scope-local behavioral instructions may override global Custom Instructions inside the Project but do not mutate owner durable state by themselves.
authority_rules.explicit_current_user_instruction: May change a requirement; material durable change must be persisted by the valid owner writer before future sessions treat it as authority.
authority_rules.memory_library_connected_apps: Context/evidence by default, not executable checkpoint authority.
authority_rules.conflict_behavior: Do not silently merge lower-authority context over fresher engineering or owner authority; reconcile through the valid owner/Continuity path.

preferred_stable_identity: repository path plus git blob/commit sha
owner artifact id plus task id
weak_identity: cached local path after session boundary
minimum_identity_and_metadata.rule: Do not perform destructive or conflict-sensitive mutation using weak identity when stable identity can be resolved.

verified_file_operation_transaction.read_freshness: A prior-chat read, cached summary or remembered content does not satisfy a current authority read when freshness is material; a partial excerpt cannot prove unseen content.
verified_file_operation_transaction.write_commit_semantics: Tool success alone is not postcondition proof. A material file mutation is committed only after reread or provider version/metadata verifies the intended result.
verified_file_operation_transaction.copy_move_semantics: Copying does not create authority. Moving/canonicalizing requires stable-reference reconciliation and removal/demotion of stale active copies.
verified_file_operation_transaction.delete_semantics: Before deletion, classify identity and check active-task, audit, publication, accepted-output and migration dependencies. If dependency/retention is unknown, do not delete.

chatgpt_library.note: User may clear Library; durable owners must remain recoverable without it.

allowed_for: owner-designated business evidence with stable Drive reference
not_allowed_as: automatic replacement for GitHub main or owner task manifest

promotion_and_cleanup.SESSION_SCRATCH_to_durable: Requires intentional write to an owner-controlled durable surface.
promotion_and_cleanup.LEARNING_EVIDENCE_to_ENGINEERING_AUTHORI: Requires explicit owner maintenance/evolution acceptance and tests/eval/acceptance evidence when testable.
promotion_and_cleanup.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_to_BUSINESS_EVIDENCE: Requires explicit task reference/provenance; connected availability alone is insufficient.
promotion_and_cleanup.CHAT_PERSONALIZATION_CONTEXT_to_DURABLE_: Requires owner persistence; remembered decision is not decision record.
promotion_and_cleanup.superseded_engineering_file: Remove from active tree when replacement authority exists and no supported migration depends on it; Git history is archive.
promotion_and_cleanup.duplicate_active_docs: Consolidate to one authority; replace duplicates with references or remove from hot path.
promotion_and_cleanup.old_task_state: Preserve/migrate by owner and Continuity rules; do not delete for cleanliness.
promotion_and_cleanup.published_or_accepted_business_artifacts: Preserve unless owner retention explicitly permits deletion and no audit/recovery dependency remains.

chat_only_material_change_rule.principle: A material idea, requirement, fix, learning or decision that exists only in chat is not durable system evolution.
chat_only_material_change_rule.before_claiming_committed: Persist the accepted change, or persist it as an unpromoted hypothesis/pending item with a stable reference.
chat_only_material_change_rule.otherwise: Use NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE or COMMIT_FAILED as appropriate; never imply future chats inherit it.

preferred_order: exact current engineering authority and artifact refs

product_surface_facts_are_not_protocol_i.rule: Current ChatGPT behavior for Custom Instructions, Projects, Memory, Library and connected apps must be reverified from first-party documentation when it materially affects a maintenance decision.
